title: UserFeedback
description: One user action on a news item or company. Stored on the user's computer.

action.description: seen: a news item was opened. visited: a career page or watchlist site was opened. useful: thumbs up (again to undo). not-useful: thumbs down (hides the item for good). undo-not-useful: undoes a thumbs down.

target.description: News item id, or company key for visited.
